definitions.explanation: The combination of qualities that form a person's distinctive character.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{性格|せいかく}がいい。
{性格|せいかく}が{合|あ}わない。
{仕事|しごと}で{性格|せいかく}が{変|か}わった。

notes:
{性格|せいかく} refers to a person's inherent personality traits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {性格|せいかく}がいい/{悪|わる}い (good/bad personality)
- {性格|せいかく}が{合|あ}う/{合|あ}わない (personalities match/don't match)
- {性格|せいかく}が{変|か}わる (personality changes)
- {性格|せいかく}{診断|しんだん} (personality test)
- {明|あか}るい{性格|せいかく} (cheerful personality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {性格|せいかく}: personality (inherent character traits)
- {人格|じんかく}: character (moral quality, personhood)
- {個性|こせい}: individuality (unique characteristics)

HOMOPHONES:
- {性格|せいかく}: personality, character
- {正確|せいかく}: accurate, precise
